# fix code string to literal PRIx64 text
obj[2]['code']='int read = sscanf(str, "%" PRIx64, &h);'
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','wb').write(json.dumps(obj,separators=(',',':')).encode())
print('wrote', open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','rb').read())
PY
cd /workspace && bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h3/README.md /workspace/candidate_trace.json
